newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil, Pennzoil set up venture.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil, Pennzoil set up venture.

text.p: Russia's biggest oil company NK LUKoil and U.S. oil group Pennzoil Co agreed on Wednesday to set up a joint venture to produce high-quality motor oils and other oil products in Russia, a LUKoil official said.

"The future joint venture will produce motor oils and other oil products by blending Pennzoil components with LUKoil ones," Mikhail Peskodarov, in charge of the protocol department at LUKoil, told Reuters.
Output will be sold under the Pennzoil and LUKoil brand names, he said.
"Pennzoil is attracted by high quality of Russian oils," he said after the two companies signed a memorandum of understanding.
Details of the project were not immediately available.
